theme_strategy: Light Theme ONLY (Per strict constraints: White backgrounds, NO BLUE, Gold accents, Black text)
emotional_archetype: Luxury SaaS (Apple + Airbnb meets High-End Service)

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing (Ultra-Elegant Serif + Crisp Geometric Sans)

scale_rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#111111]
scale_rules.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#111111]
scale_rules.h4: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-[#C89D2A]

marketing_pages.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetrical, wide gap-8 to gap-16). Prioritize massive whitespace.

dashboard_pages.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6.

cards.marketing: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#ECECEC] rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] hover:shadow-[0_16px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] transition-shadow duration-500
cards.dashboard: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#ECECEC] rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#111111] text-white px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#C89D2A] transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-transparent border border-[#ECECEC] text-[#111111] px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:border-[#111111] transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: rounded-full bg-[#C89D2A] text-white px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#111111] transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-1

glassmorphism.floating_widget: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFFFF]/80 border border-[#ECECEC] rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]

icons.styling: strokeWidth={1.25} (Ultra-thin, premium elegant look. Do not use default thickness).

motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade in using Framer Motion (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }})
motion.scroll_reveal: whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}
motion.hover_effects: Micro-interactions on all cards (y-axis lift -translate-y-1, extended shadow) and buttons.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity-20) on massive color blocks (if using #111111 backgrounds for contrast sections).
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts for dashboard. Customize colors: Primary line #C89D2A, Grid lines #ECECEC, Tooltip background #FFFFFF border #ECECEC.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped, bg-[#FAFAFA] border border-[#ECECEC] text-[#666666] text-xs tracking-wider

hero_services.description: Neatly folded clean white towels stacked. Perfect for Services or Hero background (with subtle white/black gradient overlay).

delivery_service.description: Premium delivery package handoff. Use for Delivery Service feature.

testimonials_avatar.description: Stylish woman smiling. Perfect for high-end customer testimonials or Dashboard user avatar.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Black on FAFAFA is perfect. White on #111111 is perfect. White on #C89D2A (Gold) must be checked; use slightly darker Gold for text if needed, but White on #C89D2A for large buttons is acceptable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pricing-calculator-input').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use default Tailwind blue or generic Vercel/Stripe templates.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all' globally. Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment (left-aligned text for paragraphs).
Use Framer Motion for premium, smooth scroll-triggered animations.
Use Lucide-react with ultra-thin strokeWidth (1.25) to maintain the luxury, delicate aesthetic.

Data components (Tables, Dropdowns, DatePickers) in the dashboard must use Shadcn UI but heavily customized to remove the 'default shadcn look'. Replace borders with #ECECEC, roundness to rounded-xl, and active states to Gold #C89D2A.
Dashboards should NOT feel like a completely different brand. Keep the typography (Cormorant Garamond headers, Manrope body) and generous padding alive even in data-dense views.
Never use full transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content. Always use backdrop-blur or solid #FFFFFF.
